name: apple-platform-build
description: Build, test, and verify iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS projects through Xcode's own MCP server (xcrun mcpbridge), falling back to xcodebuild when Xcode is not running. Includes simulator-verify, which drives an app in the iOS Simulator to check flows, crashes, logs and layout, and the apvt skill, which finds layout mistakes in a running simulator app.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Apple projects via Xcode MCP
defaultPrompt: Build the current Xcode project and fix any errors
Verify the feature I just changed in the iOS Simulator
Inspect the current simulator screen with apvt and fix the layout issues
